evidence.title: Fastino Releases GLiNER2.5: A Boundary-Prediction Architecture That Removes Span Enumeration From Information Extraction

summary: Fastino has released GLiNER2.5, a new architecture that predicts entity boundaries directly, removing the need for exhaustive span enumeration in information extraction pipelines. The approach promises faster, more efficient extraction and is positioned for integration into a range of downstream AI applications.
title: Fastino Unveils GLiNER2.5, a Boundary-Prediction Model Eliminating Span Enumeration for Information Extraction
